scope: Physical Cycles night-court rendering of frozen Scene09 R10
sourceGeometry: Verified existing Three.js mesh and instance buffers in export/scene.json; final R05 retains all 51,311,767 source indexed triangles including three rank2 transforms, no remeshing or decimation. Undefined inverse-transpose normals on the rank2 subset are recalculated from exact transformed geometry.
importerOrigin: Generic exact full-affine, linked Geometry Nodes and instanceColor transfer adapted from lookdev/scene01-solmax-cycles-20261021/render-current-source.py. No Scene01 world, water or scene-specific lighting retained.

sky.source: Frozen reconstructions/scene-09/src/main.js six-octave procedural night-cloud shader
sky.storage: Scene-linear float EXR; exact SHA-256 in cycles-r01/report.json; packed into the editable final model
sky.precisionLimit: CPU float64 sin/hash uses the same cloud equations with different precision from GPU GLSL, so cloud pixels are not asserted equivalent

materialInputs: Actual exported source PBR textures, UVs, colors and instance colors
Existing declared CC0 Poly Haven lacquered_cherry_wood scan
Existing declared CC0 Poly Haven rock_moss_set_01 scans and source material-space cut-stone patch
Existing declared CC0 GraniteTile04 material-space face crop in Scene09
Source authored material-space washi-tissue103 fibre and emission texture fields
Authored world-space metric submillimetre granite microrelief and water ripples; no colored highlight textures

referencePhotograph.use: Visual comparison and manual physical color/exposure calibration only

reflectionMethod: Cycles ray tracing of actual frozen scene geometry, lights and sky radiance through physical dielectric water / wet granite coatings; no scene/reflection image plate and no painted reflection strokes
editableModelDistribution: Large packed .blend and scene-linear EXR files are local release assets, excluded from Git blobs; reports retain exact size and SHA-256
